name: home-cleaning
description: Cleaners clean people's homes, by the hour or per visit, often every week.

description.description: The cleaning offered, or the home and the cleaning it needs.

price.description: The price per hour or per visit.

payment.description: How a visit may be paid: direct, visit, or both.

place.description: Where the cleaner works from and how far they go, or where the home is.

frequency.description: How often the home is cleaned; biweekly is every two weeks.

howDealsGo: The cleaner and the client agree in messages on the home, the hours, how often and who brings supplies, and pay outside Forest, usually per visit. Each may review the other. Each review names the post.
